subject: Discovery follow-up & VP/CTO intro - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ortega <tom.ortega@acmehealth.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 27 May 2029 18:12:00 +0000
Subject: Discovery follow-up & VP/CTO intro - next steps

Hi Tom / Laura —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and suggested next steps to keep momentum: 

1) Key takeaways:
- Primary use case: real-time clinical note summarization + secure embeddings for search across patient records.
- Main constraints: low 100s ms 95th percentile latency for critical flows, SOC2-level audit, and regional data residency in US-EAST.
- Success metrics: 20% reduction in clinician time per note, <3ms additional query time on search paths (target P95).

2) Technical unknowns we flagged:
- Expected average sequence length and peak batched request volumes (helps us recommend instance/quantization profile).
- KMS/HSM preference for key management.

3) Proposed next steps:
- Executive alignment (VP / CTO intro) — 30-45 min: high-level architecture, risk/SLA discussion, procurement timeline.
- Technical deep dive — 60 min: model/latency tradeoffs, infra footprint, integration plan with your EHR.

Tom / Laura — would you be open to a short exec alignment call this week to introduce your CTO/VP and unblock procurement? If yes, here are slots my team has open (all ET):
- Wed 5/29 11:00-11:45am ET
- Wed 5/29 3:00-3:45pm ET
- Thu 5/30 9:00-9:45am ET

If those don't work, tell me two windows that do and I will align calendars. We can follow the exec call with a technical deep dive that includes our infra lead (Dev) and solutions engineer (Lukas).

Attaching a 1-pager exec brief and the requirements workbook we asked you to confirm.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182
